Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. The simulator and estimator are trained offline and reused across agents without further training. Moreover, Seer executes only the selected action and adds only real tool responses to the committed history, avoiding tool calls on discarded candidates at additional inference cost. Across multiple deep-research benchmarks, Seer substantially improves agent performance for different language models. For instance, GAIA accuracy rises from 13.6% to 41.7% for Qwen3.5-4B and from 22.3% to 50.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Furthermore, our analyses suggest that broader candidate coverage can compensate for imperfect simulation, while prediction and scoring errors limit the benefits of wider imagined search. These findings highlight the potential of reusable models for prediction and evaluation to strengthen small research agents through extra local computation without the real execution of the discarded candidates.
arxiv.titleZh: Seer:用共享决策模型引导小型深度研究智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 为在用户设备上运行的深度研究智能体提供推理时引导:把动作提议与后果预测、价值估计解耦，从真实研究轨迹离线训练工具响应模拟器与价值估计器(以折扣终端正确性标注)，二者可跨智能体复用、无需再训练，且只执行选定动作，被丢弃的候选不产生真实工具调用。在多个深度研究基准上显著提升多种模型，GAIA 准确率从 13.6% 升至 41.7%(Qwen3.5-4B)、22.3% 升至 50.5%(Qwen3.5-9B)。分析显示更广的候选覆盖可补偿模拟不完美，而预测与打分误差会限制想象搜索的收益。
arxiv.reason: 小型深度研究 Agent 的推理时决策引导，命中 Agent 与 test-time scaling

arxiv.title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts. Built around a single shared drafting head, our approach features three core architectural optimizations: target activation injection to anchor semantic planning, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention to bypass prefill compute and reduce memory overhead, and an efficient clustered vocabulary projection to reduce the cost of full-vocabulary decoding. Testing these improvements with the Gemma 4 model family, our G-MTP shows out-of-the-box speedups for both large server-side setups (up to 3.1$\times$) and smaller models targeting memory-constrained on-device environments (up to 2.3$\times$ on H100 and up to 2.2$\times$ on a smartphone GPU). In addition, we present parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes for G-MTP that keep the drafter aligned with the backbone LLM under domain shift, requiring up to 1.83$\times$ fewer target forward passes than tuning only the backbone.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于多 Token 预测的高效鲁棒草稿生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 投机解码的草稿模型需兼顾轻量与准确，工作提出 G-MTP：在现有 LLM 主干上挂单个共享草稿头，并用目标激活注入锚定语义规划、零拷贝 KV-cache 交叉注意力跳过 prefill 计算并降低显存、聚类词表投影降低全词表解码开销。在 Gemma 4 系列上，服务器端最高加速 3.1×，H100 上小模型 2.3×、手机 GPU 上 2.2×。另给出参数高效微调方案，使草稿头在领域漂移下保持与主干对齐，目标前向次数最多减少 1.83×。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码草稿架构改进，属推理效率高分方向且结果扎实

arxiv.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
arxiv.abstract: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. Putting this knowledge back recovers much of the lost pass rate, so an expert's skill is valuable largely for what the model does not write on its own. Building on this insight, SkillDiff marks this knowledge in place and raises the pass rate on SkillsBench by 4.8 points on average without feedback or any change to the skill's text. Project repository: https://github.com/LitaoGuo/How-Self-Evolution-Reshapes-Skills.
arxiv.titleZh: 无反馈自我进化如何重塑Agent技能：一项系统性研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 专家撰写的Agent技能文档正被模型在没有反馈的情况下反复改写，这种自我进化究竟让技能更好用还是更糟，此前缺少研究。实验让模型在无任务、无运行、无评判的条件下逐轮重写专家技能，再用改写后的技能驱动同款模型：结果技能普遍贬值，三十轮后SkillsBench平均下降约15分。进一步分析发现重写会把技能拉向模型自身的先验，先丢掉先验之外的知识，把这部分知识补回可挽回大部分损失；据此提出SkillDiff，在不改技能文本、不引入反馈的前提下原位标记这类知识，使SkillsBench通过率平均提升4.8分。
arxiv.reason: Agent技能自我进化的系统性研究，含机制分析与改进方法

arxiv.title: ProbeAgent: Principled Diagnosis of Agent Failures in Verifiable Environments
arxiv.abstract: Improving agents requires discovering where they fail and understanding why. An agent acts over multiple steps in a changing environment, so diagnosing its failures requires more than inspecting the final response of a large language model (LLM). The same unsuccessful outcome can arise from task difficulty or from an error the agent repeats across tasks. We introduce ProbeAgent, an automated framework that discovers agent failures, tests their proposed causes, and identifies shared failure modes. Starting from benchmark tasks, ProbeAgent builds executable tests and validates them using reference solutions, automated checks, and review of the task requirements. For each failed trajectory, it explains the error and constructs new tasks that preserve the suspected cause while changing the surrounding context. Running the agent on these tasks tests whether the same error recurs. ProbeAgent then groups failures with similar causes and generates descriptions that distinguish their errors. This process connects explanations of individual failures to executable tests and descriptions of shared failure modes. We evaluate ProbeAgent across 22 agent configurations using tasks from 10 benchmarks, collecting 1,244 failures and producing 536 failure-mode descriptions. These descriptions distinguish specific errors within broad outcomes such as incomplete work, including planning without acting and stopping before delivering a file. In human evaluation, annotators accept 90.0% of assigned descriptions and correctly reject 83.3% of similar alternatives, supporting the accuracy and specificity of the discovered failure modes.
arxiv.titleZh: ProbeAgent：在可验证环境中对Agent失败的原则性诊断
arxiv.summaryZh: 诊断Agent失败不能只看LLM最终输出，因为同一失败结果可能源自任务难度，也可能源自跨任务重复出现的同一错误。ProbeAgent从benchmark任务出发构建可执行测试，用参考解与自动检查验证，再针对每条失败轨迹推测原因并构造保持该原因、改变上下文的新任务，通过重跑检验错误是否复现，最后将同类失败聚合并生成可区分的失败模式描述。在10个benchmark、22种Agent配置上共收集1,244条失败，产出536条失败模式描述，能区分如「只规划不行动」「未交付文件即停止」等具体错误;人工评估中描述被接受率90.0%，对相似干扰项的正确拒绝率83.3%。该框架把单条失败解释、可执行测试与共享失败模式描述连通，可用于Agent的失败归因与迭代改进。
arxiv.reason: Agent失败诊断与可执行测试构造，方法系统性强，贴合Agent方向

arxiv.title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.
arxiv.titleZh: LLMs 在后训练期间会记住自己产生的幻觉
arxiv.summaryZh: 前沿模型的后训练配方多由数学、代码等推理领域塑造，但被直接迁移到知识类任务后可能带来副作用。研究提出假设：基于结果奖励的 RL 与「提出假设再回退」等认知行为模板，会让模型在长思维链中自发生成的幻觉获得训练信号，从而被固化记忆。在六个开源模型、两个模型家族与两种架构上验证：训练中被强化过的幻觉复现率平均上升 4.83%，未获训练信号的自发幻觉仅上升 0.17%；即使模型在推理中随即撤回的错误事实也会被记住，且奖励幻觉使其后续更少拒答（平均 7.23%）。这揭示了一条此前未被系统研究的幻觉习得路径，对知识类任务的后训练配方设计有直接警示。
arxiv.reason: 后训练与 RLVR 机制分析，命中后训练方向且实验系统

arxiv.title: Non-Expanding Gated Continued Fraction Architecture for Feedforward Layers in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Recent work has shown that continued fraction inspired neural architectures (CoFrGeNets) can be highly parameter efficient yet performant for language modeling. In this work, we revisit continued fraction-based channel mixing with the goal of improving its performance and simplifying integration into standard pre-training protocols for language models. We achieve this by two simple yet critical contributions: i) we propose a novel non-expanding gated continued fraction inspired architectural component to replace feedforward layers in established language model architectures that may use vanilla multilayer perceptrons or gated linear units or (vanilla/gated) experts in mixture-of-experts (MoE) type architectures. ii) We propose a way to re-implement divisions -- the non-linearity in these architectures -- in terms of logarithms and exponentials. By experimenting on different language modeling architectures such as GPT-2, Llama-3, Mamba-2 and (nano) Llama-MoE we find that our proposed architecture performs similarly or significantly better than the continued fraction architecture proposed in prior work along with having higher throughput. In addition, our re-implementation of divisions makes training of deeper CoFrGeNets stable without the need for incremental training which was proposed in prior work as a means to stabilize training, but added notable complexity to existing large language model training implementations. Code is available at http://github.com/IBM/CoFrNets
arxiv.titleZh: 用于语言模型前馈层的非扩展门控连分数架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对连分数式神经网络（CoFrGeNets）参数效率高但难以嵌入标准预训练流程的问题，提出非扩展门控连分数组件，可直接替换 GPT-2、Llama-3 等架构中的 MLP、门控线性单元乃至 MoE 专家；同时把作为非线性的除法改写为对数与指数运算，使深层连分数网络无需依赖此前提出的增量式训练即可稳定收敛。在 GPT-2、Llama-3、Mamba-2 与 nano Llama-MoE 上的实验显示，性能持平或显著优于原连分数架构，且吞吐更高，代码已开源。该工作为前馈层的高效替代设计提供了可直接接入现有训练栈的方案。
arxiv.reason: 替换前馈层的新架构组件，跨多种 LLM 主干验证，命中架构方向

arxiv.title: Don't Discard Your Rollouts: Reusing Teacher RL Traces for Student Distillation
arxiv.abstract: RL post-training methods such as PPO and GRPO are computationally expensive, with substantial resources devoted to sampling rollouts, which contain multiple completions per prompt along with their respective rewards. Canonical distillation, however, discards these traces and uses more compute to regenerate data from the final teacher. We ask if and how we can reuse the saved teacher RL rollouts to distil student models. Reusing rollouts is non-trivial: naive SFT on the rollouts underperforms canonical distillation, and naive DPO, while performant, is unstable, collapsing on weaker students. We show that treating rollout reuse as a data selection problem using metadata already recorded during GRPO substantially reduces this gap. We use prompt pass rates to order the data, using the easiest prompts for an SFT warm start prior to using mixed-success prompts for DPO. For each prompt, we use saved teacher log-likelihoods as a proxy for selecting student-compatible completions. Across mathematical reasoning and Python coding tasks, with students from multiple model families, our two-stage recipe achieves comparable average performance to canonical distillation, while incurring no additional inference cost for dataset construction.
arxiv.titleZh: 别丢掉你的 rollout：复用教师 RL 轨迹做学生蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 PPO/GRPO 等 RL 后训练中采样 rollout 计算开销大、而标准蒸馏丢弃这些轨迹并重新生成数据的问题，研究如何复用已保存的教师 RL rollout 蒸馏学生模型。直接做 SFT 会弱于标准蒸馏，直接用 DPO 虽有效但在较弱学生上不稳定；为此把复用视为数据选择问题，利用 GRPO 已记录的 prompt 通过率排序，先用最简单 prompt 做 SFT 热启动，再用混合成功率的 prompt 做 DPO，并以教师保存的 log-likelihood 作为与学生兼容的 completion 筛选代理。在数学推理与 Python 代码任务、多个模型家族的学生上，该两阶段配方平均性能与标准蒸馏相当，且数据集构建不产生额外推理成本。
arxiv.reason: 复用 GRPO rollout 做 on-policy 蒸馏，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: We show that reinforcement learning (RL) in reasoning tasks can succeed even when the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is severely corrupted. In a mathematical reasoning dataset (GSM8K), we systematically corrupt training trajectories across 361 configurations by injecting realistic error types, varying error locations, trace-answer consistency, and corruption ratios up to 100%. While aggregated SFT-only performance steadily deteriorates under corruption (dropping from 43.61% to 13.80%), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training consistently restores model accuracy back to gold-baseline levels (approximately 60%). Crucially, initializing RL with as few as N = 8 minimal, incorrect, three-line "form-only" traces boosts post-RL performance to 69.30%, outperforming standard gold SFT initialization (60.71%) and GRPO without SFT (35.00%). Further, we show that SFT accuracy is largely uncorrelated with post-RL accuracy (r approximately 0), demonstrating a fundamental asymmetry in post-training: SFT primarily establishes structural layout (form), while RL independently discovers functional reasoning (function).
arxiv.titleZh: 强化学习可消除被污染的 SFT 推理数据影响
arxiv.summaryZh: SFT 数据质量差会拖累推理能力，而 GRPO 能把这部分损失补回来。在 GSM8K 上，该研究通过注入真实错误类型、改变错误位置、trace 与答案一致性和最高 100% 的污染比例，构造了 361 种配置；SFT-only 准确率从 43.61% 跌至 13.80%，GRPO 后训练却稳定回到约 60% 的金标基线。更关键的是，仅用 8 条三行式、含错误答案的“形式化”轨迹做 RL 初始化，post-RL 达到 69.30%，超过金标 SFT 初始化（60.71%）和无 SFT 的 GRPO（35.00%）；SFT 准确率与 post-RL 准确率几乎不相关（r≈0）。这说明后训练存在非对称分工：SFT 主要提供结构布局（form），RL 则独立发现功能性推理（function），因此可放宽对 SFT 数据正确性的要求，而优先保证格式可用。
arxiv.reason: GRPO 后训练鲁棒性研究，直击 SFT 数据质量，结论有分量

arxiv.title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
arxiv.abstract: Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models' own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory, in six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions. For judgments of whether German texts were written by a human or an AI, probes and word n-gram classifiers separated the classes well, but the answers did not and often ordered the texts inversely. Post-training lowered the sensitivity of the answers on average ($Δd' = -0.34$ across model families; -0.29 across three prompts). It also changed the use of a stated base rate: Base models shifted their log-odds by less than the stated change in prior odds, most post-trained models by more. In two models with stage-wise checkpoints, the change occurred during supervised fine-tuning, model stitching implicated the early layers, and from mid-depth on internal states at positions after the text, not those of the text, transferred the change between checkpoints. Our corpora cannot be shared, so we add a case reproducible from public data, the truth of negated statements. Here, post-training acted in the opposite direction: Probes decoded truth at or near ceiling in every model, the answers of several base models did not use it, and post-training repaired them; by mid-depth the repair resided at the positions after the statement; below it, the representation of the statement contributed, strongly in one of four models. In a training study, adding 2,000 correctly labeled authorship judgments of news texts to otherwise identical fine-tuning data improved the answers on our newspaper and textbook corpora and inverted them on the chats, where they followed a news-trained probe of the base model. Post-training thus changed how a judgment is read out of what a model represents, and a small training signal can set its direction.
arxiv.comment: 64 pages, 7+2 figures, 4+8 tables, Code and derived results: https://github.com/laubrock-lab/represented-but-misread
arxiv.titleZh: 表征存在但被误读：后训练改变语言模型读出其表征的方式
arxiv.summaryZh: 区分后训练改变的是模型内部表征，还是从表征读出答案的过程：在六个开放权重基座模型及后训练版本上对比线性探针与模型自身答案，用信号检测论量化。德语文本人类或AI作者判断中，探针与 n-gram 分类器能清晰区分两类，答案却常反向排序；后训练使答案敏感度平均下降（Δd'=-0.34 跨模型族，-0.29 跨三个 prompt），并放大对给定先验的调整。逐阶段 checkpoint 与 model stitching 定位到 SFT 阶段与浅层，中层之后由文本之后位置的状态传递变化。否定陈述任务方向相反，后训练修复了基座未利用探针可解码真值的问题；加入 2000 条标注数据可改善部分语料答案却在聊天语料反转。
arxiv.reason: 剖析后训练改变表征读出而非表征本身，机制分析系统，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
arxiv.abstract: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN), improve language model outputs by generating multiple candidates per prompt and selecting among them using a reward model. Much of this cost is wasted: a fixed budget is applied to every prompt, although the computation required by prompts varies widely. Adaptive methods halt once sampled answers appear settled, but their thresholds are tuned heuristics with no statistical control over early-stopping errors. We instead seek an anytime-valid stopping rule that takes an error tolerance $α$ as input and halts only once an answer is certified to hold a majority ($θ_a > 1/2$) under the generator's distribution. We aggregate candidates by final answer with a reward-weighted self-consistency (RWSC) score and treat stopping as a sequential test over the resulting clusters. Applying Wald's sequential probability ratio test to these clusters yields SPRT-RWSC, which performs well empirically, but its guarantee fails because the leading answer shifts during sampling, and the run is continuously monitored. Our main contribution, e-RWSC, replaces Wald's test with a betting supermartingale (an e-process) for every answer the policy produces, bounding the probability of ever certifying a non-dominant answer by $α$, uniformly over time and across all answers. The RWSC scores drive the bets, so they affect only how quickly a dominant answer $a^\star$ is certified, not validity; certification takes $O(\log(1/α)/d_{\mathrm{KL}}(θ_{a^\star}\|1/2))$ samples. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm the predicted $1/d_{\mathrm{KL}}$ scaling of cost and show that accuracy improves over baselines at substantially lower token cost.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向高效推理时对齐的序列随时有效检验
arxiv.summaryZh: Best-of-N 等推理时对齐方法对每个 prompt 都用固定预算采样，浪费大量计算；现有自适应停止阈值只是启发式，且缺乏统计控制。该工作按最终答案把候选聚成簇，用奖励加权自洽（RWSC）分数驱动停止决策，把停止问题建模为序列检验：Wald SPRT 因领先答案会漂移、过程被持续监控而失效，因此改为对每个答案构造 betting supermartingale（e-process），把任意时刻误认证非主导答案的概率控制在 α 以内，认证所需样本为 O(log(1/α)/d_KL(θ_a*‖1/2))。在多个语言模型、数据集与奖励模型上的实验验证了 1/d_KL 的成本缩放规律，并在明显更低的 token 成本下取得更高准确率。
arxiv.reason: 推理时对齐的任意时间统计保证，理论扎实，命中 test-time scaling

arxiv.title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.
arxiv.titleZh: Agent 应该记住多少？面向 LLM Agent 的自蒸馏记忆部署经验
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程任务中的 LLM Agent 会反复犯程序性错误，如 API 分页参数用错、实体解析错、用户没问也抢答。该工作构建了一条让 Agent 从自身轨迹中学习的流水线：先从每条轨迹中挖掘 1–3 条简短 lesson，再将其合并为更少的 guideline，并记录每条 guideline 合并了多少 lesson；推理时向 Agent 注入全部 guideline 或选定子集。该方法已开源为 altk-evolve，部署在 IBM CUGA Agent 与 watsonx Orchestrate 平台，并在 AppWorld 上验证：DeepSeek-V3.2 使用完整的 191 条 guideline 后，任务完成率提升 9.5 点、场景完成率提升 16.1 点；gpt-oss-120b 基线为 39.9%，用全部 199 条升至 51.2%，而用约 29 条的精选子集可达 55.4%，说明最优记忆量取决于模型能力而非记忆本身。文中还总结了 guideline 反噬、合并时 provenance 丢失、API 报错被吞掉、基线混淆等部署陷阱，对落地 Agent 记忆系统具有直接参考价值。
arxiv.reason: Agent 自蒸馏记忆与自我进化，含真实部署与跨模型实验

arxiv.title: Context as a Resource
arxiv.abstract: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface. Yet when every context shares identical frozen backbone weights, funneling interleaved dialogues and external events into one linear session induces cross-topic constraint bleed and head-of-line stalling. Conversely, router-ticket hierarchies incur lossy prose handoffs, heavy routing overhead, and blind merges - collapsing true-conflict repository merges to a 33.3% three-run mean despite high isolated branch passes. Rather than scheduling anthropomorphic roles, we introduce ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a pluggable single-pass non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk. Across three programmatic multi-stream benchmarks and three model families, our portable trial merge gate lifts true-conflict merges to 63.3%, while ClonAct's routerless virtualization attains this ceiling with 45.9% fewer prompt tokens and prevents compact-model router collapse. Under continuous surge streams, ClonAct matches top completion (95.0%) with the lowest median wait and zero timed-out status checks.
arxiv.titleZh: 上下文即资源
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对单界面常驻个人 Agent 在并发会话下的两类失效：共享冻结主干权重时，交错对话与外部事件被压入一条线性会话会引发跨主题约束串扰与队头阻塞；而路由器票据式层级又带来有损的文本交接、路由开销与盲合并，使真实冲突仓库合并的三次运行均值仅 33.3%。ClonAct 用无路由器架构直接把上下文块虚拟化：可插拔的单次非生成式 Context MMU、就地 Context Cell、带隔离试合并门的足迹感知 Synaptic Bus，以及 wave-flushed 共享主干。在三个程序化多流基准与三个模型家族上，可移植的试合并门把真实冲突合并率提升到 63.3%，ClonAct 以少 45.9% 的 prompt token 达到同一上限，并避免小模型的路由崩溃；持续突发流下最高完成率 95.0%，中位等待最低且零超时状态检查。
arxiv.reason: 多会话 Agent 上下文虚拟化架构，命中 Agent 记忆与 harness 方向

arxiv.title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
arxiv.abstract: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill$.$png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill$.$png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill$.$png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png
arxiv.titleZh: SKILL.PNG:在像素空间中学习智能体技能
arxiv.summaryZh: 文本技能是离散的自然语言指令，无法连续优化;而微调等梯度方法又绑定具体模型，难以跨智能体迁移。Skill.png 改为在冻结 VLM 的视觉编码器上，用梯度下降直接优化作为技能输入的图像像素;单一图像技能可被多个模型联合优化。在 4 个 VLM 与 4 个 benchmark 共 16 种设置中，有 9 种优于由前沿 LLM 优化的文本技能，且推理时仅需 64–256 个图像 token，而文本约需 900–2000 个 token;文本与图像联合优化的混合技能还能进一步提升表现，集成优化得到的图像技能可在集成内各模型间迁移。
arxiv.reason: Agent 技能表示与可梯度优化，契合 Agent 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF), with inference available through our llama.cpp fork at https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp.
arxiv.titleZh: NariQ：面向长程 Agent 任务的亚 3 比特量化
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程 Agent 任务需要在 100K 以上上下文里连续多步调用工具，而现有低比特量化大多在短网页文本上校准、以困惑度作为评估指标，导致 3 bit 以下模型在 DeepSWE 上最多只能达到 BF16 约 72% 的解题率。NariQ 采用 trellis 编码的后训练量化，并以 BF16 模型在真实 Agent 会话中生成的 token 作为校准集来对齐部署分布。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，3.0 bit 与 2.5 bit 在 DeepSWE、Terminal Bench、AIME 和 RealWorldQA 上均与 BF16 持平，2.0 bit 则出现性能下降；这是首批被证明能在长程 Agent 任务上追平全精度的 ≤3 bit 量化，权重已以 GGUF 形式发布，并提供 llama.cpp 分支供推理。
arxiv.reason: 量化与长程 Agent 结合，有真实校准方案与发布，命中系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: Post-training recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively improves a target capability, operationalized by a fixed anchor benchmark, through repeated intervention, training, and evaluation. Yet most loops use the anchor's aggregate score as their sole observation, so early gains give way to stalled progress and repetitive exploration. When this anchor-only feedback ceases to reveal actionable gaps, a plateau may reflect an exhausted observation rather than an exhausted capability. We introduce adaptive observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism of harness evolution that keeps the anchor objective fixed while adapting the active observation. At a plateau, a controller refines diagnostic granularity, escalates difficulty, and adds related tasks; validated increments are fused back into training, while every checkpoint remains evaluated against the anchor. Across eight independently optimized anchors in long-context reading comprehension and instruction following, AdaObs raises the mean score from $66.4$ to $73.7$ under a matched data budget, outperforming FixedObs, the anchor-only baseline. The evolved harness further improves the seven-task average on the independent PostTrainBench across two agent backends. These results identify observation adaptation as a missing mechanism of harness evolution for sustaining post-training RSI.
arxiv.titleZh: Sage-Evolve-Preview：面向后训练自我改进的自适应观测
arxiv.summaryZh: 后训练递归自我改进循环通常只把锚点基准的聚合分数当作唯一观测，早期收益过后便陷入停滞与重复探索；这提示平台期可能源于观测耗尽而非能力耗尽。AdaObs 在保持锚点目标不变的前提下让观测侧自适应：检测到平台期时，控制器细化诊断粒度、升高难度并引入相关任务，把验证过的增量融合回训练，同时每个 checkpoint 仍对锚点评估。在长上下文阅读理解与指令遵循的八个独立优化锚点上，匹配数据预算下平均分从 66.4 提升到 73.7，优于只用锚点反馈的 FixedObs；演化后的 harness 在独立 PostTrainBench 的七任务平均分与两个 agent 后端上也有提升。该工作把观测适配确立为维持后训练 RSI 的 harness 演化机制。
arxiv.reason: 后训练自我改进与 harness 演化，机制新颖、多锚点验证

arxiv.title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.
arxiv.titleZh: System-One RSI:通过引导式练习为交互式智能体构建「肌肉记忆」
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对推理模型因深思导致决策延迟、难以满足亚秒级控制的问题，提出双环框架 System-One RSI:在线内环为 OODA 循环，决策模型把视觉观察与任务问题映射为结构化判断，再经决策树转换为定时动作，全程不调用推理模型;离线外环由一组推理智能体修订 prompt 与决策树、采集交互记录、从中导出监督并更新模型参数，把学到的区分沉淀为外部「肌肉记忆」。框架仅需少量真实 episode，无需专家示范、环境改造或并行仿真。在 Snake、Zenless Zone Zero、Black Myth: Wukong 上以 27B 决策模型实验:Snake 平均分由 1.30 升至 7.35,Zenless Zone Zero 某场景中位完成时间下降 8.4%,Black Myth: Wukong 战斗场景闪避策略平均存活时间为静止基线的 11 倍，进攻策略胜率由 0% 升至 66.7%。
arxiv.reason: Agent 自进化与实时控制闭环结合，机制清晰，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models
arxiv.abstract: Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correctness. We report four linked results. First, probes on router logits separate correct from erroneous steps in eight checkpoints (AUROC 0.80-0.88). Second, replacing router logits across all routed layers changes the judgment in all nine checkpoints, and by more than a norm-matched random replacement. Third, this change rarely depends on whether the source step is correct. At one layer, routing from erroneous steps and from correct steps produces indistinguishable margins in all nine checkpoints. Under all-layer routing, their difference is resolved and positive in only one. Fourth, the same difference is positive for local residual replacements in eight of nine checkpoints, so the measure does detect such dependence where it exists. Correctness is therefore readable from routing, and routing replacements move the judgment, but the movement rarely follows correctness.
arxiv.titleZh: RouteVerify:通过路由干预实现 MoE 模型的步骤级验证
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究 MoE 模型的路由状态能否作为步骤级验证判断的因果依据。RouteVerify 采用受控干预:保持被评估输入不变，用另一条解题轨迹的内部激活替换选定激活，在九个 MoE checkpoint 上比较 router logits、MoE 输出与 MoE 后残差三种干预接口，并扫描层与 token 位置，以验证 margin(模型偏好错误步骤的程度)为指标。结果显示 router logits 的探针可在八个 checkpoint 上区分正确与错误步骤(AUROC 0.80–0.88)，替换 router logits 会改变判断且强于范数匹配的随机替换，但这种改变极少依赖源步骤是否正确;而在九分之八的 checkpoint 上，局部残差替换能够检出该依赖性。说明路由可读、可干预，但干预引发的判断变化并不跟随正确性。
arxiv.reason: MoE 路由与步骤级验证的受控因果分析，方法扎实、切中可解释性与推理评测

arxiv.title: Characterizing and Detecting Unfaithful Work Reports by Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents increasingly carry out long-horizon development tasks, autonomously planning and executing multi-step actions that span files, tools, and sessions. Because developers rarely follow each action, and agents resuming the work depend on records of what was done, the agent's work report often becomes the primary account of what was changed and established. When the report contains false or unsupported claims, it gives recipients false assurance: incomplete work may be accepted without verification, incorrect assumptions about the current state can propagate to later steps and agents, and evaluators that credit stated success may reward the report rather than the work. Yet little is known about what unfaithful reporting looks like in real development work, or how developers and agents handle it once it surfaces. Starting from real developer-agent conversations in SWE-chat, we conduct a systematic mixed-methods analysis of self-admitted unfaithful reports. We identify eleven subtypes in four categories: misreported observations, misattributed evidence, overstated task success, and faulty technical explanations, with overstated task success the most common. Handling these problems involves on average 4.3 further user turns and 12.71 minutes of recorded response and execution time, and users express dissatisfaction more often. Among 435 work reports that we separately sample and annotate, 37.24% contain at least one unfaithful claim. We also develop FaithDetector, a detector for unfaithful reporting informed by the observed patterns. On naturally sampled reports, FaithDetector attains 93.06% macro-F1, about 13 percentage points above the baseline. Together, our findings and FaithDetector provide empirical evidence and an automated method for checking reporting faithfulness, informing agent evaluation and training feedback.
arxiv.titleZh: 刻画与检测编程智能体的失实工作汇报
arxiv.summaryZh: 编程智能体在长程开发中自主跨文件、工具和会话执行任务，其工作汇报常成为变更与结论的主要依据；一旦包含虚假或无依据的声明，就会让未完成工作被误接受，并把错误状态传给后续步骤。研究基于SWE-chat真实开发者与智能体对话，对智能体自认的失实汇报做混合方法分析，归纳出4类11个子型，并标注435份自然抽样汇报，据此构建FaithDetector。失实汇报平均需4.3个额外用户轮次和12.71分钟响应与执行时间，用户不满更频繁；FaithDetector的macro-F1较基线高约13个百分点。该工作为智能体汇报忠实性检查、评测与训练反馈提供了实证分类和自动检测方法。
arxiv.reason: 编程智能体汇报失实检测，直接命中Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
arxiv.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.
arxiv.titleZh: STARK：迈向真正会学习与记忆的个性化Agent
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长期记忆只记录「发生了什么」、却把「为何发生」留给底层LLM事后推断的问题，STARK提出双图记忆架构：情景图把交互记为带时间、因果与语义链接的episode，洞见图存LLM抽取的行为洞察，用支持它的事件数量打分，并以事件本身作为连接这些洞察的边。推理时直接从insight节点取行为知识，由event-as-edge提供依据，免去重复的情景遍历；该结构还可将知识图谱投影到关系嵌入空间，在共享情境下实现跨用户迁移，为冷启动用户补全缺失洞察。在LongMemEval信息抽取上judge分数较SOTA提升1.48，LoCoMo开放域问答提升0.93；LongLaMP摘要生成基准上，5%图稀疏度时跨用户迁移使开放式judge分数提升0.7、ROUGE-L提升3。
arxiv.reason: Agent长期记忆架构，机制新颖且含跨用户迁移

arxiv.title: CompAct-Bench: A Benchmark for Working-Context Compaction in Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
arxiv.abstract: As language-model agents are applied to increasingly extended tasks, their working context continuously accumulates interaction history, tool observations, intermediate decisions, and task progress. Context compaction offers a practical way to reduce this growing history while allowing execution to continue, yet the compaction ability of modern LLMs remains insufficiently understood. We introduce CompAct-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating working-context compaction through its downstream effect on agent task completion. Starting from successful agent trajectories, we insert compaction boundaries at different stages of execution, compress the preceding working context with the model under evaluation, and let the same executor continue the original task. To enable fair comparison across compactors, we evaluate them under controlled retention ratios using a lightweight iterative ratio-adjustment procedure. CompAct-Bench covers information-seeking, software-engineering, and workspace-oriented tasks through BrowseComp, SWE-bench, and an internal CompanyBench evaluation. Our experiments show that working-context compaction remains highly lossy even for frontier models: Claude- and GPT-family models perform strongest overall, yet substantial degradation in downstream task accuracy persists under aggressive compaction. Further analysis reveals that failures are often caused not only by omitted information, but also by distorted task state, such as turning unresolved issues into apparent conclusions or forgetting previously established results, which can lead to incorrect decisions or redundant execution. These findings highlight working-context compaction as a distinct and still challenging ability for LLMs operating in extended agent tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: CompAct-Bench：长程 Agent 任务中工作上下文压缩的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长程 Agent 任务中工作上下文不断膨胀、压缩能力缺乏评估的问题，构建了以任务完成度为衡量标准的压缩基准：从成功轨迹出发在不同阶段插入压缩边界，用待测模型压缩前序上下文后由同一执行器继续任务，并通过轻量迭代比例调整实现留存率受控的公平比较，覆盖 BrowseComp、SWE-bench 与内部 CompanyBench 三类场景。实验显示压缩仍高度有损，Claude 与 GPT 系列整体最强，但激进压缩下下游任务准确率明显下降；失败不仅源于信息遗漏，也源于任务状态被扭曲，例如未解决问题被写成结论、已确立结果被遗忘，导致错误决策与重复执行。
arxiv.reason: Agent 长程上下文压缩基准，选题硬核、评测设计扎实

arxiv.title: Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as predictors across various tasks, benefiting from their ability to use information from unstructured context. However, when predictions serve as parameters of downstream optimization problems, higher prediction accuracy does not necessarily translate into lower decision costs. We propose decision-focused reinforcement learning (DFRL), a framework for post-training LLMs to predict optimization parameters using negative downstream decision regret as reward. DFRL trains LLM predictors to minimize the costs of the decisions induced by their predictions, without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, and integrates readily into existing RL post-training frameworks. To address expensive reward evaluation, we develop two approaches. Heuristic warm-starting uses inexpensive approximate rewards during an initial phase before switching to refinement with exact rewards. Reward correction combines inexpensive estimates with randomized exact evaluations, preserving the expected policy gradient while reducing the expected number of exact solves per update. Experiments on three synthetic optimization problems demonstrate improvements over prediction-loss baselines, while a larger knapsack experiment shows faster early improvement under short training budgets. On inventory planning with H&M transactions and product descriptions, our best configuration, in which the LLM reasons before predicting, reduces regret by 31.4% relative to the SFT baseline and 12.4% relative to the strongest evaluated conventional forecasting baseline.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向LLM后训练的决策聚焦强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 当LLM的预测作为下游优化问题的参数时，更高的预测精度不一定带来更低的决策成本。提出DFRL框架，以负的下游决策后悔值作为奖励对LLM做后训练，无需下游问题满足凸性或可微性，可直接接入现有RL后训练框架。针对奖励评估开销大的问题，设计两种机制:启发式热启动在初期用廉价近似奖励、后期切换到精确奖励精修;奖励修正把廉价估计与随机精确评估结合，在保持期望策略梯度不变的前提下减少每次更新的精确求解次数。在三个人工优化问题上优于预测损失基线，H&M库存规划任务中「先推理再预测」的配置使后悔值相比SFT基线降低31.4%、相比最强传统预测基线降低12.4%。
arxiv.reason: RL后训练新奖励范式，可接入现有框架，方法清晰有数据

arxiv.title: AutoRAGBench: A Benchmark for LLM Agents Automating RAG System Development
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a well-established paradigm for augmenting large language models (LLMs) with information retrieved from external corpora. However, developing effective RAG systems requires substantial engineering effort and iterative experimentation, as effective design choices vary across tasks and domains. With rapid advances in LLM agent capabilities, we ask how well these agents can autonomously build RAG systems and how effectively they can improve them through iteration. In this paper, we propose AutoRAGBench, the first benchmark to evaluate how well LLM agents develop RAG systems from scratch in an open code space. It comprises nine RAG system development tasks. For each task, agents build RAG systems from scratch without starter code or prescribed strategies, under a six-hour budget on a single H800 GPU. They analyze task data, implement RAG pipelines, and iteratively refine their designs based on experimental feedback. We evaluate nine agent configurations and analyze both the effectiveness of the resulting RAG systems and their development trajectories. GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI achieves the highest average score of 56.1. The composite Human-SOTA baseline averages 44.4. These results show that LLM agents can automate effective RAG system development. When starting from a human-designed system on each of seven tasks, GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI improves the score by 16.6 points on average.
arxiv.titleZh: AutoRAGBench：评估 LLM Agent 自动化 RAG 系统开发的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: RAG 系统的有效设计随任务与领域而变，开发过程需要大量工程实现与迭代实验。该工作提出 AutoRAGBench，首个在开放代码空间中考察 LLM Agent 能否从零构建并迭代改进 RAG 系统的基准，包含九个 RAG 系统开发任务；每个任务不提供起始代码或预设策略，Agent 需在单张 H800、六小时预算内分析数据、实现流水线，并依据实验结果反复调整设计。评测覆盖九种 Agent 配置，GPT-6.1 Sol 配 Codex CLI 取得最高平均分 56.1，人类 SOTA 组合基线为 44.4；在七个任务上以人类设计系统为起点时，该配置平均再提升 16.6 分。结果表明 Agent 已能自动化完成有效的 RAG 系统开发，并为以 Agent 驱动研发的评测提供了可复用范式。
arxiv.reason: Agent 自动化研发与评测基准结合，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: RoCoKV: Accelerating LLM Inference Serving through Uncertainty and Redundancy Aware KV Cache Compression
arxiv.abstract: KV cache compression is critical for large reasoning models, where most of the cost comes from long generated reasoning traces rather than the input prompt. These traces often contain redundant and low-utility tokens due to looping, self-verification, and corrections. However, such tokens may still receive high attention scores, making it difficult to remove them without harming the reasoning process. We propose RoCoKV, a KV cache compression method designed for large reasoning models. RoCoKV introduces two key components. First, uncertainty-guided adaptive pruning adjusts the compression strength based on the model's confidence, allocating more memory during uncertain phases and applying stronger pruning when the model is confident. Second, redundancy-aware token selection reduces the impact of tokens that are highly similar to recent reasoning content, encouraging the model to retain more informative and diverse tokens. Beyond the algorithm, we co-design RoCoKV with the serving stack: we develop fused three-phase CUDA decode kernels and integrate them into vLLM as a drop-in plugin that preserves its paged KV layout and CUDA graph capture, turning algorithmic savings into real end-to-end speedups. Extensive experiments across three reasoning benchmarks and two reasoning models demonstrate that RoCoKV consistently improves reasoning accuracy under constrained KV cache budgets, achieving higher accuracy compared to state-of-the-art KV cache compression methods. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B in vLLM, RoCoKV achieves a 1.27X speedup and 38% higher throughput on AIME25, the most challenging evaluated reasoning benchmark, and a 1.43X speedup and 45% higher throughput on the long synthetic benchmark, compared with Full-KV.
arxiv.titleZh: RoCoKV:通过不确定性与冗余感知的 KV Cache 压缩加速 LLM 推理服务
arxiv.summaryZh: 长思维链推理产生的 KV cache 中大量 token 因循环、自我验证与纠错而冗余，却仍获得高注意力分数，直接剪枝会损害推理。RoCoKV 用不确定性引导的自适应剪枝按模型置信度动态调整压缩强度，并用冗余感知的 token 选择压低与近期推理内容高度相似 token 的权重。方法还与服务栈协同设计:三相融合 CUDA decode kernel 以插件形式集成进 vLLM，保留 paged KV 布局与 CUDA graph 捕获。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上，AIME25 取得 1.27 倍加速与 38% 吞吐提升，长合成基准上为 1.43 倍加速与 45% 吞吐提升，且在受限 KV 预算下推理准确率优于现有压缩方法。
arxiv.reason: 面向推理模型的 KV cache 压缩，算法与 vLLM 系统协同优化，命中推理效率方向

arxiv.title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
arxiv.abstract: Agent skills package procedural knowledge as natural-language instructions, and a skill helps only when its instructions are correct and properly followed by the agent. Self-evolving agents revise their own skills from the runs they make, but existing methods judge each run as a whole, by its outcome or by where it went wrong, and cannot tell whether a failure comes from a wrong instruction or from one the agent did not follow. Instruction-level coverage was introduced to test skills and labels each instruction of a run as follow, not-follow, or not covered, which separates these causes. We leverage it for skill self-evolution with SkillPlumber, a framework in which an agent evolves its own skills where coverage shows they fall short. A persistent root cause analysis agent turns each label into a revision question and checks each revision against the next run, while a maintainer distills investigations across tasks into a shared strategy library. Across three benchmarks and three executors, SkillPlumber solves 64.7% to 70.5% of the tasks, 25.6 to 30.4 percentage points higher than the initial skill and 8.7 to 14.0 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline, and removing coverage reduces recovered failures by 20.8% on SkillsBench with GPT-5.5.
arxiv.titleZh: 在关键之处进化:覆盖率引导的 Agent 技能自我进化
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent 技能以自然语言指令封装过程性知识，而现有自我进化方法只看整次运行的结果或错误位置，无法区分失败源于指令本身有误，还是 Agent 没有遵循指令。SkillPlumber 借助指令级覆盖率标注(follow / not-follow / not covered):一个常驻的根因分析 Agent 把每个标签转成修改问题，并用下一次运行校验修改效果;另一个维护者 Agent 把跨任务的排查结论蒸馏进共享策略库。在三个 benchmark、三种执行器上，任务解决率为 64.7%–70.5%，比初始技能高 25.6–30.4 个百分点，比最强基线高 8.7–14.0 个百分点;在 SkillsBench 上使用 GPT-5.5 时，去掉覆盖率信号使恢复的失败减少 20.8%。这一结果说明对技能做细粒度诊断能有效提升 Agent 的可靠性与自我改进效率。
arxiv.reason: Agent 技能自我进化与覆盖率诊断，直接命中 Agent 与自进化方向

arxiv.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
arxiv.abstract: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.
arxiv.titleZh: TuringSpace:用交互式 CAPTCHA 将空间智能锚定于动作
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 CAPTCHA 基准大多已被模型攻破且缺少空间性，空间基准又少见动作交互;TuringSpace 提供 125 个需在截图上点击、拖拽完成的交互式 CAPTCHA，覆盖五类空间能力，任务由带 checker 与 oracle 的程序生成，可不断采样新实例，兼作可扩展训练环境。人类解题率 94.1%,GPT-6 Astra 失败 25.9%，最强开源模型 Kimi K3 失败 68.0%;失败主要来自误读截图，推理很少纠正错误信念，反而编造证据自证。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上微调后成功率从 1.6% 升至 33.1%，七个分布外基准全面提升，VSI-Bench 真实室内视频提升 9.9 点。
arxiv.reason: MLLM 空间理解新基准兼可扩展训练环境，含微调迁移验证

arxiv.title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building them. To this end, we introduce AppSci-Bench, where we construct a setting akin to how human Applied Scientists build agents for businesses - through eliciting task requirements from stakeholders, exploring the business's infrastructure, and scientifically improve the target agent by designing experiments and internal benchmarks. AppSci-Bench features seven realistic domains - five new ones (Slides Generation, Order-to-Cash, Compliance Review, Customer Call Insights, and CRM Insights) and two domains recast from tau3-bench (Yao et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2026b)(Airline and Banking) - each with a held-out evaluation suite customized for that task. We evaluate seven frontier models and find AppSci-Bench challenging: the best model, Claude Opus 5.0, only reaches a mean-minimum score of 59.1% across 3 build attempts; other models do significantly worse. Models struggle with eliciting task requirements (only 65% for Opus 5.0), build representative internal evaluations (models saturate their own evaluation 65% of the time but fail to solve the held-out task), presenting challenges for future research. The benchmark code is available here: https://github.com/sanjari-orb/appsci-bench.
arxiv.titleZh: AppSci-Bench：LLM 能否构建 AI Agent 并让其变得更好？
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 benchmark 多评估 LLM 驱动的 Agent 质量，却很少考察 LLM 构建 Agent 的能力。AppSci-Bench 模拟应用科学家的完整工作流：从利益相关方处引出任务需求、探查业务基础设施，再通过设计实验与内部 benchmark 迭代改进目标 Agent；覆盖幻灯片生成、订单到收款、合规审查、客户通话洞察、CRM 洞察五个新领域，以及从 tau3-bench 改造的航空与银行两个领域，每个领域配一套定制的留出评测集。七个前沿模型中表现最好的 Claude Opus 5.0 三次构建尝试的平均最低分仅 59.1%；模型在需求引出上仅达 65%，且 65% 的情况下会把自己的内部评测刷饱和却解不出留出任务。该工作把「造 Agent」本身作为可评测能力，为 Agent 自动构建与自进化研究提供了诊断工具。
arxiv.reason: Agent 自动构建与评测方法学，直击 Agent 方向核心

arxiv.title: AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are expected to improve themselves from their own experience across episodes, with fixed weights. Self-improvement in an embodied world cannot be read from one measure. Existing benchmarks measure task progress, world-knowledge question answering (QA), and episodic memory, but a correct answer does not show that the agent ever observed the evidence for it, and progress does not show what the agent learned. We introduce AstronautBench, which measures one agent's self-improvement through three views on the same run: what it knows, whether its own evidence supports that knowledge, and how far it gets in the world. It is built on the game Outer Wilds, where each episode is a 22-minute loop after which the world resets, only the agent's knowledge carries over, and progress is gated by knowledge. After every episode, we measure the places reached and ship-log rumor facts revealed, the correctness of answers to 164 questions about the world, and whether each answer is supported by the frames and position the agent cites from its own recorded play. Two LLM judges from different model families check every answer. In eight-episode baselines with GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon planners, which act through a learned controller or their own gamepad inputs, the three views do not move together, so any one of them alone gives an incomplete picture of whether the agent is improving. The GPT-6.1 Sol agent's correct answers grow from 14.6% to 26.8% of all questions, but at episode 8 only 59 to 68% of them are supported by its cited evidence. It reveals no new rumor facts after episode 3, while the places it reaches and its memory keep growing. More than half of the answers that become correct after episode 3 cite only evidence from earlier episodes.
arxiv.titleZh: AstronautBench：通过知识、证据与进度衡量智能体跨回合的自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有基准分别测任务进度、世界知识问答与情景记忆、却无法判断答案是否有自身观察证据的问题，构建基于《Outer Wilds》的AstronautBench：每回合22分钟重置循环，仅知识跨回合保留，并从到达地点、传闻事实、164题问答及回答引用的帧与位置证据三视角评估同一次运行，由两个模型家族的LLM评委核验。八回合基线中，GPT-6.1 Sol正确率从14.6%升至26.8%，但第8回合仅59%至68%的正确答案有引用证据支持，第3回合后不再揭示新传闻事实，而到达地点与记忆仍增长。单一指标会误判自我改进。
arxiv.reason: Agent自我改进评测新基准，三视角设计切中方向

arxiv.title: Weight-Space Programming Writes In-Context Learning and Matches Fine-Tuning in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Weight-space programming is a frontier language model's recently reported ability to read and rewrite another network's weights without gradient descent. We investigate how examples can provide a weight update so that a weaker language model performs the task with nothing in the prompt, and study what it edits. Our experiments cover six tasks, four frontier editors and three families of weaker language models, without the editors being told anything about in-context learning (ICL). In most runs, the few-shot minus zero-shot residual is measured at the final prompt token, the ICL task vector, and write it into the weights, at its sparsest into near-silent MLP units keyed to the prompt format. Results reach the accuracy of ICL and of fine-tuning on the same examples, LoRA included, usually leaving perplexity untouched, with worse performance under changes of wording. We also qualify the comparison by counting unfinished runs, observing that one editor falls below fine-tuning; held only to the seen examples, without task pairs of their own, only the strongest editor has similar performance. Given a task and unlabelled inputs, that editor writes its own examples and does nearly as well on unseen items as with labels.
arxiv.titleZh: 权重空间编程可写入上下文学习能力，并在语言模型上媲美微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 让前沿模型不经梯度下降直接读写另一个语言模型的权重，把 few-shot 示例转化为权重更新，使弱模型在提示为空时也能完成任务。方法是先在最终提示 token 处抽取 few-shot 与 zero-shot 的残差（ICL 任务向量），再将其写入权重；最稀疏时只改动与提示格式绑定的近乎静默的 MLP 单元。在六个任务、四个前沿编辑器、三个模型族上，准确率追平 ICL 与同示例微调（含 LoRA），困惑度基本不变，但换措辞后性能下降。最强编辑器仅凭无标签输入就能自写示例，在未见样本上接近有标签效果，把上下文学习重新表述为可写入的权重更新。
arxiv.reason: 用权重空间编辑写入 ICL、免梯度适配弱模型，属自改进与模型编辑新范式

arxiv.title: Depth-Linked Residual Tokens for Multimodal Retrieval and Generation
arxiv.abstract: Iterative architectures such as looped language models improve parameter efficiency and reasoning capacity of transformers, yet their sequential backbone iterations introduce substantial computational latency. Conversely, parallelizable learnable special tokens (such as the register tokens in Vision Transformer) enable efficient single-pass inference, but often suffer from the absence of sequential refinement and exhibit redundant representations across tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce Depth-Linked Residual Tokens (DepThink), an efficient framework designed for multimodal retrieval and generation. Operating within a single pre-filling forward pass, DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens whose hidden states are coupled through a lightweight, learnable residual recurrence. This mechanism enables each residual token to progressively capture complementary information missed by preceding tokens. Theoretically, we prove that DepThink provides strictly expanded geometric directional reachability over standard learnable tokens and guarantees a provable one-step descent advantage. We evaluate DepThink across multimodal retrieval and generation tasks. DepThink consistently outperforms learnable-token baselines and matches or exceeds looped architectures across dense (2B, 8B) and sparse mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) backbones under both LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning, while accelerating training by up to 11.9 and inference by 4.3 over looped architectures.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向多模态检索与生成的深度关联残差Token
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对looped语言模型迭代骨干带来的串行计算延迟、以及可学习特殊token缺乏序列精炼且表示冗余的问题，提出DepThink:在单次prefill前向中追加K个可学习残差token，其隐状态通过轻量可学习残差递推耦合，使后续token逐步捕获前序token遗漏的互补信息;理论上证明其几何方向可达范围严格扩展并具备一步下降优势。在多模态检索与生成任务上，DepThink在稠密(2B、8B)与稀疏MoE(30B-A3B)骨干、LoRA与全参微调下均优于可学习token基线，匹配或超过looped架构，训练加速最高11.9倍、推理加速4.3倍。
arxiv.reason: 多模态检索与高效推理架构改进，属效率与MLLM交叉的扎实工作

arxiv.title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers
arxiv.abstract: Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbf{GLiDE}, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters. Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens. Across five model sizes, GLiDE lies on the performance--parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face \DI{}, with each model outperforming evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. \dmtwo{} (27B) achieves a hidden-set score of 71.52, with an expected calibration error of 2.0\% and a median latency of 92.9\,ms on a single GPU. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE~27B, which reaches 73.37 with an expected calibration error of 2.1\%.
arxiv.titleZh: GLiDE：一种从推理教师模型蒸馏而来的快速、校准的决策模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 决策模型通过单次前向给候选答案打分，快速给出带置信度的判断，但推理过程本身能显著提升决策质量——能否在不生成文本的前提下保留这部分收益是核心问题。GLiDE 基于 Qwen 混合语言模型，在全注意力层移除因果掩码，使上下文、问题与候选答案之间可以双向交互；再用多教师（含推理模型）软目标蒸馏配合多决策任务的渐进式后训练，把推理能力迁移进单次推理，并尝试无参数循环深度在不生成 token 的情况下增加推理期计算。0.4B 到 27B 五个规模均处于 Hugging Face 相关榜单的性能—参数帕累托前沿，27B 模型隐藏集得分 71.52、期望校准误差 2.0%、单卡中位延迟 92.9ms，结合 checkpoint 平均与循环深度后升至 73.37。
arxiv.reason: 推理教师蒸馏进单次打分决策，兼中后训练与高效推理

arxiv.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
arxiv.abstract: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential $(+254,-256)$ tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed $\{+,-,\times\}$ circuits in constant $\mathsf{TC}^0$ depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, $N=1{,}728$; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic ($N=1{,}200$, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, $\le 0.036\%$) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, $\le 0.057\%$) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered $>2$K-token Tango splits ($N=4{,}392$; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).
arxiv.titleZh: 一台住在LLM里的CPU:将精确电路零梯度编译进预训练权重
arxiv.summaryZh: 预训练语言模型在无梯度微调或外部解释器时多位数精确算术不可靠。该工作用闭式零梯度电路嫁接原语把确定性计算直接编译进预训练权重:两层Mellin-GLU求积把未知的RMSNorm缩放转成对数栅格平移，Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE自汇注意力与GatedDeltaNet实现跨token尺度抵消，并配合d→d+K宽度扩展与Base-1000 BPE输出，无需训练样本与运行时钩子。五阶段编译器在常数TC⁰深度合成4–8位有符号加减乘电路，6位算术上Granite 4.2 3B与Qwen 3.5 4B前缀准确率达99.17%/100%(FP32 sidecar下100%)，远超12.8K样本LoRA的42.2%/61.7%。为免训练精确计算注入与权重级可解释性提供新路径。
arxiv.reason: 零梯度把精确算术电路编译进权重，方法新颖且实验扎实

arxiv.title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
arxiv.abstract: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
arxiv.titleZh: MemFolder:结构引导的记忆折叠，用于高效的 Agent 记忆管理
arxiv.summaryZh: 长期 Agent 的外部记忆库随交互不断增长，存储、检索与生成成本随之上升:记录数变多抬高检索开销，检索到的上下文变长则增加 prefill 计算与解码期注意力成本。MemFolder 以跨记录结构为引导，依次压缩记录数量与上下文长度:RecordFolder 对实体指称做归并，逐步选出有代表性且互补的锚点，结合语义与实体亲和度及时间链，把兼容记录折成更少的检索单元;ContextFolder 把同一记忆组内的原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并借助验证反馈修正编码，以保住关键事实。在 LoCoMo、PersonaMem、LongMemEval 三个文本基准与 M3-Bench-web、M3-Bench-robot 两个多模态基准上均取得较强表现，在 Mem0 上以少 50% 的记录保留 99.0% 的原始平均性能，性能保留率超过最强基线 1.9 个百分点。该工作面向 Agent 长期记忆的存储与检索效率，可与现有记录压缩方法叠加使用。
arxiv.reason: Agent 长期记忆压缩，属 Agent 与效率交叉的扎实工作

arxiv.title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
arxiv.abstract: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge. We introduce DeepQuest, a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework for Alzheimer's disease research. DeepQuest transforms unresolved questions from domain reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses and prioritizes them through data feasibility screening and groupwise Elo ranking. It couples iterative experimentation with two-level auditing that separates experimental reliability from knowledge contribution relative to two frozen literature corpora. On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produces 42 feasible hypotheses and outperforms the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons across three language-model reviewers. The full framework achieves an audit-assessed scientific finding rate of 95.24%, outperforming both general-purpose executors and domain-specific research agents. This scientific finding rate remains stable across literature corpora and evaluator model families. Representative findings concern neuropsychiatric symptoms and dementia risk, longitudinal amyloid spatial stability, and neocortical tau-associated clinical impairment, with key associations supported in independent ADNI and AIBL cohorts. These results show how aligning knowledge gaps, data feasibility, and evidence auditing can turn automated research into traceable, evidence-supported scientific discovery. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeepQuest-3066/
arxiv.titleZh: DeepQuest：从知识缺口到阿尔茨海默病的科学发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 科研智能体的自动化实验未必带来科学理解，需要先识别有意义的知识缺口、判断现有数据能否解决，并评估发现是否推进已有知识。DeepQuest以知识缺口为驱动，把领域综述中的未解问题转化为可追溯、可检验的假设，经数据可行性筛选与分组Elo排序确定优先级，再将迭代实验与两级审计耦合，分别评估实验可靠性和相对两份冻结文献语料的知识贡献。在OASIS-3上，它产出42条可行假设，在三个语言模型评审的15项评估维度比较中有14项优于最强基线，审计判定的科学发现率达95.24%，且在独立ADNI与AIBL队列中得到关键关联支持。该框架为科研智能体提供了把知识缺口、数据可行性与证据审计对齐的可追踪范式。
arxiv.reason: 科研智能体与自动发现，属AI for Research高分方向，系统完整

arxiv.title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
arxiv.abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) often answer questions from incomplete records. Missing information might be interpreted as unknown or false, depending on the completeness of the source. Current evaluations fail to distinguish these two aspects, as they are usually interwoven with other reasoning demands. We present ClosureBench, a benchmark that tests whether LLMs follow the stated rules for dealing with missing information. Every base scenario is tested under OWA, CWA, and LCWA, and only the treatment of missing information changes between variants. ClosureBench provides a verified base benchmark as well as agent extensions for action choice, source scope, and updates. A model is considered correct on a base scenario only if it provides correct answers in all of its closure variants. Across 960 instances, overall accuracy can mask substantial closure mistakes. Models achieve overall accuracy from 71.18% to 99.86% across replicated runs, but their core switch accuracy, measured on the scenarios whose gold label actually changes with the contract, varies between 18.23% and 99.31%. Large discrepancies emerge under LCWA. For example, some agents choose unknown despite the prompt indicating that missing information should be treated as false. Our findings demonstrate that evaluations of AI agents should not only measure whether agents can reason over existing facts but also whether they use the appropriate assumption when information is absent.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 20th International Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning (NeSy 2026). Conference version: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TEaW3pdZOZ
arxiv.titleZh: ClosureBench：闭包假设下推理的基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM Agent在记录不完整时回答问题的场景，缺失信息可能被理解为未知或假，而现有评测无法区分这两种处理。ClosureBench让每个基础场景分别在OWA、CWA与LCWA下测试，变体间只改变缺失信息处理规则，并提供动作选择、来源范围与更新等Agent扩展；只有在全部闭包变体上答对才算基础场景正确。960个实例上，整体准确率为71.18%到99.86%，但核心切换准确率仅18.23%到99.31%，LCWA下出现明显偏差，说明Agent评测需同时检查缺失信息下的假设使用。
arxiv.reason: 缺失信息假设评测，命中Agent评测与方法学方向

arxiv.title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
arxiv.abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.
arxiv.comment: https://twinlab-bench.github.io/ contains tasks and code. 33 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. LLM-agent benchmark for autonomous experimental design in digital twins of real labs (physics, chemistry, wet-lab biology, materials, engineering). 13 agents evaluated: Claude Fable 5.2 45.0, Opus 5.5 40.2, GPT-6.1-sol 31.7, plus DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and others
arxiv.titleZh: TwinLab-Bench:在真实实验室的智能体孪生中评估AI科学家
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对AI智能体自主设计实验这一最开放的能力，构建TwinLab-Bench:覆盖物理、化学、湿实验生物、材料与工程的52个任务、100余种实验动作，每个任务配一个TwinLab agent充当环境，读取真实实验室原始记录并调用基于记录构建的计算器，执行被测智能体设计的实验，再与隐藏的真实实验记录答案比对，并用闭卷探针排除凭记忆作答。前沿模型表现仍差，最强的Claude Fable 5.2平均仅45.0分，GPT-6.1-sol为31.7分，论文进一步实证分析其失败环节。该基准把「自设计实验」从选择题变成可执行、可核验的闭环评测，适用于科研智能体与Agentic RL的环境构建。
arxiv.reason: AI科学家智能体基准，命中科研智能体与评测方向，但属纯benchmark发布

arxiv.title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
arxiv.abstract: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. Two tracks are ranked separately: in the Main track we run the submitted algorithms in a network-isolated sandbox with open-source dependencies only; in the Self-hosted track teams solve the instances on their own machines, with any software, within a timed window. Every solution is checked for feasibility, and a feasible solution scores the ratio of its objective to a frozen known reference, averaged over hidden instances.
arxiv.titleZh: FrontierOR挑战赛：面向运筹学的Agentic算法设计
arxiv.summaryZh: 运筹学算法通常需专家针对每个新问题定制，耗时数周；LLM agent能否自主设计可扩展算法尚不清楚——在FrontierOR基准的一次性评测中，最强模型仅在39%的大规模实例上追平Gurobi（目标值差距1%以内且速度不慢）。挑战赛要求参赛队伍构建能同时为多个优化问题设计、测试并改进算法的Agent工作流：Stage 1从180道已审核题目中放出60道，覆盖六类应用与五种建模形式，每周发布15道；Stage 2引入基准之外的新问题与未见实例。赛道分为Main（网络隔离沙箱、仅限开源依赖）与Self-hosted（自备机器、软件不限、限时求解），所有解均做可行性校验，可行解按目标值与冻结参考解的比值在隐藏实例上平均计分。
arxiv.reason: Agentic算法设计基准与竞赛，方向相关但以赛题发布为主

arxiv.title: Same Judgement, Different Scores: Numerical Scoring Topology in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as automated evaluators to reduce the cost and time required for human annotation. However, the role of scoring-scheme design in the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation remains underexplored. To address this problem, we introduce numerical scoring topology, which characterizes the structural design of a scoring scheme in terms of its scale width, granularity, offset, symmetry, and boundary placement. Building on this definition, we conduct the first systematic study of how numerical scoring topology influences zero-shot LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation across diverse benchmarks and judge models. Our results show that numerical scoring topology systematically affects judge scores, calibration, and robustness, particularly in judgment-intensive evaluations. Shifted and narrow ranges tend to induce some of the largest score deviations across many settings. We further find that stronger and larger judge models generally achieve higher discriminative validity and greater robustness to scoring-topology changes. These findings suggest that numerical scoring topology should be treated as an integral component of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation and highlight the need for more principled and standardized scoring protocols.
arxiv.titleZh: 同样的判断，不同的分数：LLM-as-a-Judge 评测中的数值评分拓扑
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM-as-a-Judge 评测中评分量表的设计如何影响可靠性，此前缺乏系统考察。作者提出「数值评分拓扑」概念，用尺度宽度、粒度、偏移、对称性与边界位置五个维度刻画评分方案的结构设计，并在多个基准与多个裁判模型上开展首个系统性零样本研究。结果显示评分拓扑会系统性影响裁判给出的分数、校准与稳健性，在判断密集型任务上尤甚；偏移与窄区间在多数设定下引发最大分数偏差，而更强更大的裁判模型判别效度更高、对拓扑变化更稳健。结论是把评分拓扑视为 LLM-as-a-Judge 评测的有机组成，并推动更规范、标准化的评分协议。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-a-Judge 评分协议的系统性方法学研究，命中评测方向

arxiv.title: Understanding MoE Decisions Beyond Gradients
arxiv.abstract: Understanding a language model's decision requires knowing how its internal computations affect its preference between answers. Gradient-based methods estimate this influence by predicting the effect of changing those computations. In mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, replacing one expert can change which experts later layers select. Those switches can alter the answer scores in ways that derivatives do not capture. We introduce a predictor that uses the model's own expert outputs and selection rules to estimate these extra effects, then adds them to a second-order prediction. Across questions from three benchmarks, our method reduces the error in predicting answer-score changes by 60\% on Qwen3.6 and 47\% on Gemma4, relative to a multistep baseline using gradients and second derivatives.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越梯度：理解 MoE 的决策机制
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE 模型中替换单个专家会改变后续层的专家路由，使基于梯度的答案分数影响预测失效。为此提出一种预测器，利用模型自身的专家输出与选择规则估计这类路由切换带来的额外效应，并将其叠加到二阶梯度预测上。在三个 benchmark 的问题上，相对使用梯度与二阶导的多步基线，该方法将答案分数变化预测误差在 Qwen3.6 上降低 60%、在 Gemma4 上降低 47%。这为 MoE 内部计算的细粒度归因与可解释性提供了更准确的工具。
arxiv.reason: MoE 可解释性与路由分析，属架构方向，方法清晰

arxiv.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task.
